title: Real-data Grunfeld structural data-validation benchmark
scope: V1 machine-checkable structural validation against EXPLICITLY DECLARED metadata/rules: (a) declared-key duplicate detection; (b) selected-variable missingness counts/rates; (c) row-count / observation-count consistency; (d) required-variable presence + declared type consistency; (e) sample-flow arithmetic consistency; (f) merge cardinality (1:1 / 1:m / m:1) ONLY when a merge + expected relationship is explicitly declared. It does NOT infer economic ranges/units automatically, does NOT decide sample exclusions, does NOT impute/delete/recodify or repair data.
artifact_construction_source: domains/economics/benchmarks/data_validation/results/python.json (data.val.python.pandas). The bundle builder is a MAP-ONLY adapter: it does not re-implement data-cleaning/repair and does not re-derive scientific estimates. R-independent cross-engine check is provided by the Stata result (results/stata.json).

adversarial_cases.merge_cardinality: fixtures/merge_left.csv + merge_right.csv -> DV_MERGE_CARDINALITY fail (expected 1:1, observed m:m)

no_op: Does NOT promote any implementation to verified. tested scope is exactly the demonstrated structural checks on the frozen Grunfeld real dataset plus the synthetic/adversarial defect-detection evidence; NOT generic data-cleaning, NOT automatic sample exclusion, NOT automatic unit/range inference, NOT verified.
